LanguageData.NeatEdges.DesignatorExpandDesc: Paint tiles whose edges stay crisp. Terrain stops fading into a painted tile, and the painted tile stops fading into its neighbours.\n\nPainting is free and instant: nothing is built, and nothing is drawn on the map.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.DesignatorClearDesc: Remove tiles from the hard edge area, so their edges fade as normal again. Hard edge markers standing on those tiles keep working.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.OverlayToggle: Show hard edges: every tile with a hard edge marker on it, and the painted hard edge area.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.AdoptedAreas: Neat Edges took over the hard-edged areas you painted with Perspective: Paths. Paint or clear them from the Floors tab of the Architect menu.
